learning_rule: No learning; rewrite rules are declared.
inference_rule: Delete zero nodes, then cancel pairs of one nodes.
communication: Ordered binary node list in; residual graph cardinality out.
hardware_assumptions: Mutable ordered graph storage is available.

complexity_claims.bound: at most one deletion per zero plus one cancellation per pair of ones

energy_hypothesis: Graph materialization likely costs more memory movement than one-bit state; this is unmeasured.

falsifiers.observation: A fully reduced graph has more than one node.
falsifiers.consequence: Reject the declared rewrite system for parity.
